description: Erection of  two storey side and single storey rear extension and single storey front  porch  extension with pitched roof. Alterations to the existing  parking access and  front garden. Erection of new wall and fencing with side and access gates. Creation of new vehicular crossover and parking spaces  to the house. Demolition of existing garden outbuilding.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Existing site location plan (unnumbered, 1:1250) and block plan (unnumbered, 1: 500), E0001(P2), Existing elevations (untitled, unnumbered), Existing GF and FF plans (untitled, unnumbered), Existing loft and roof plans (untitled, unnumbered), P1001(P2), P1003(P3), P20000 (P2), P30000(P2), P300001(P2), Fire safety statement - Received 25/03/2025; P10001(P4), P10000(P4), P1002(P4), P30002(P4)� Received 26/05/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevations of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 5 - The vehicular access hereby approved must be constructed in accordance with the submitted drawings. The off-street parking area must be a minimum of 4.8 metres deep and a minimum of 2.4 metres wide. 

Reason: In order to protect the appearance of the and in the interests of highway safety.

Condition : 6 - Before the vehicle access hereby approved is first brought into use, the existing vehicular access as shown on dwg ref: P1002(P4) shall be permanently closed and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
Reason: In order to enhance the pedestrian environment and to confine vehicular access to the permitted points to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway.

Condition : 7 - Either side of the vehicle access hereby approved, visibility splay areas (the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, with a splay of at least 2.4 metres x 2.4 metres) shall be provided before the access and parking area is brought into use.  These areas shall be kept clear of any obstructions to visibility greater than 600 mm in height, including shrubs, planting, boundary walls, fences, gates, other means of enclosure or other structures or objects at all times.
Reason:  To ensure adequate visibility for drivers entering and leaving the site in the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety.
